AI Assistant

CSCA AI Assistant

A focused AI guide for CSCA subject choice, syllabus reading, university research, and scholarship route navigation. This first public version is coming soon.

Coming soon

Your CSCA study copilot for subjects, syllabus, universities, and scholarships

CSCA AI Assistant is being built as a practical education assistant, not a generic chatbot. It is designed to help international students ask clearer questions about the CSCA exam and get grounded guidance based on the materials already organized in CSCA Prepare.

Ask About Early AccessBrowse Subject Guides

Current Stage

Coming soon / preview page

Primary Role

Education guidance assistant

First Scope

Core, syllabus, universities, scholarships

What the assistant is being designed to help with

The first public version is intentionally narrow. It is meant to answer the most common planning questions students ask before they choose subjects or commit to a preparation path.

CSCA core questions

Explain what CSCA is, how registration works, how score release fits into planning, and what students should verify from official sources.

Subjects and syllabus

Help students understand what math, physics, chemistry, humanities Chinese, and STEM Chinese actually cover before they over-collect materials.

University navigation

Show students how to use a university directory as a research tool and how to move from broad school discovery into deeper official verification.

Scholarship route clarity

Give a simpler first explanation of CSC, provincial, and university scholarship paths without pretending that unofficial summaries replace official notices.

Built around a curated CSCA knowledge layer

The goal is to make this assistant more useful than a broad AI search box. Instead of answering from a random internet blend, it is being shaped around curated CSCA preparation materials, structured syllabus summaries, scholarship navigation notes, and university directory guidance already organized on this site.

Answer only within the current knowledge scope instead of guessing missing rules.

Separate route guidance from official verification so students know what still needs confirmation.

Help users move into the right next page instead of leaving them with abstract advice.

Why this page exists before the full tool is live

This preview page gives students, directories, and future partners a clear public description of the product direction. It also makes it easier to explain what the AI assistant is for before the first interactive release is opened more broadly.

For students

It explains what the assistant will help with and what kinds of planning questions it is meant to support first.

For AI directories

It provides a stable product page that describes the product clearly enough for submissions, listings, and future backlinks.

For future rollout

It creates a clean public URL now, so the page can grow into the live assistant later without changing the destination.
